note: Behavioural families of the model history. A family describes what the user wants and which tool calls a correct system makes; it is independent of seed rule names. Slot values are what a careful human annotator reads from the message, never what the parser extracts.

slotTypes.day: {"rel": N} = N days after the user's local today (0 today, 1 tomorrow, 2 day after tomorrow, -1 yesterday) or {"weekday": "mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun"} = the next such weekday strictly after today. A weekday equal to the clock's weekday is ambiguous: label it route=ai why=ambiguous_day.
slotTypes.time: 24-hour "HH:MM". Only when the message fixes it unambiguously (explicit minutes like 10:30, a 13-23 or 00 hour, am/pm, утра/вечера/дня/ночи, полдень, полночь). A bare hour 1-12 ("в 10", "в 3") is NOT fixed: label route=ai why=bare_hour.
slotTypes.period: today|tomorrow|week|next_week|month|next_month|weekend. week = today and the six following days.
slotTypes.ref: {"id": N} (user wrote #N) or {"title": "..."}: the words the user used for the event; must match exactly one world event by case-insensitive substring of its title
slotTypes.title: the title the created or changed event should get, as a careful human would write it (case-insensitive compare, titleAlt lists acceptable variants)
slotTypes.invitee: "@username" of a world user (ivan_petrov, anna_smith, mark_t1)

inScopeDefinition: A message is in scope when it is ONE complete, unambiguous request with every required slot present that maps to exactly one family below. Anything else (missing slot, bare hour, several requests, bulk, negation, advice, chit-chat) is route=ai.

calendar.day.desc: what is on my calendar on one day (relative word, weekday name or a date)

calendar.period.desc: what is on my calendar this week / next week / this month / next month / the weekend

calendar.upcoming.desc: what is next / my nearest events (optional count)

calendar.search.desc: find my events about a topic or by title

calendar.when.desc: when/what time/where is a named event (answered from the event's start)

calendar.count.desc: how many events on a period

calendar.image.desc: show my calendar for a day/week/month as a picture

slots.day.desc: when am I free on a day

slots.check_time.desc: am I free at a specific time on a day

event.show.desc: show one event by number or exact title

event.create.desc: create an event with a title, a day and a fixed time; any word order, with or without a verb ("добавь", "поставь", "запиши", "встреча завтра в 15:00", "завтра в 15:00 созвон"); also reminders phrased as "напомни завтра в 10:00 позвонить врачу" (title = what to do)

event.create_range.desc: create an event with an explicit start and end ("с 10:00 до 11:30")

event.create_invite.desc: create an event and invite a named @username in one message
event.create_invite.tools: after yes create_event then send_invitation(event_id, invitee_username)

reminder.after.desc: remind me in N minutes/hours to do something

event.delete.desc: delete/cancel one event named by title or number; the word "event" is optional
event.delete.tools: search_events or get_event, then after yes delete_event(event_id)

event.reschedule.desc: move one event to another day and/or a fixed time; at least one of day/time is given; a missing part keeps the event's current value

event.set_detail.desc: set the location or description of one event

event.snooze.desc: push one event later by N minutes/hours

reminder.set.desc: remind me N minutes/hours before a named event

reminder.clear.desc: remove the reminders of one event

reminder.list.desc: which reminders does one event have

invite.send.desc: invite a @username to one existing event

invite.status.desc: who is invited to / has answered for an event

time.now.desc: what time is it now (here or in a city)

aiReasons.bare_hour: the time is a bare hour 1-12 without am/pm/part of day, so morning vs evening is not fixed
aiReasons.missing_slot: a required slot (time, day, title, target) is absent
aiReasons.ambiguous_day: weekday equals today's weekday or the day is otherwise unclear
aiReasons.bulk: applies to many events ("все встречи", "всё на завтра")
aiReasons.multi_request: two or more separate requests in one message (other than create + invite of the same event)
aiReasons.negation_or_quote: negated, hypothetical, quoted or reported speech ("не создавай", "что значит удали")
aiReasons.advice_or_analysis: asks for judgement or planning ("когда лучше", "стоит ли", "оптимизируй")
aiReasons.chitchat: greetings, thanks, jokes, general knowledge, weather, anything unrelated to the calendar
aiReasons.past_or_invalid: date in the past for a create/move, impossible date, or a time that does not exist
aiReasons.unsupported: calendar-related but beyond the families above (location search, attachments, sharing a calendar, Google sync details)
